title: Permanent Transit Camp tenements for Slum Rehabilitation Scheme / Rental Housing
scope: Construction of Permanent Transit Camp (PTC) tenements for SRA relocation OR Rental Housing. Allows total FSI on gross plot to exceed base up to 4.00.
not_permitted_on: Lands reserved/designated for existing amenity in DP

tenement_specifications.commercial_handover: Free of cost to SRA (for project-affected commercial tenements)
tenement_specifications.alternative_use: Residential transit tenements can be used for Govt Staff Quarters etc.

release_of_additional_fsi.correlation: Additional FSI over Zonal is released in correlation to BUA of tenements handed over free of cost to SRA/MCGM
release_of_additional_fsi.tdr_alternative: TDR permitted in lieu of unconsumed sale component of additional FSI

sequencing_condition.trigger: Transit camps must be handed to SRA before OC, water, power connection released for other portions

clubbing_provisions.eligibility: Two or more PTC/rental-housing schemes by same/collaborating owner-developer-society with CEO(SRA) approval
clubbing_provisions.what_can_be_combined: Both rehab and sale components; can be located in any proportion across plots
clubbing_provisions.condition: Total FSI per Table A must not be exceeded on any plot AND clubbing must yield independent plot/building/wing with SRA component handed over

premium_case_A_sra_shift_to_lower_asr_pl.unearned_income: Difference in open land ASR rate × BUA at receiving plot
premium_case_A_sra_shift_to_lower_asr_pl.payment_stages: 50% at IOA of extra sale, 50% at CC

premium_case_B_base_fsi_shift_between_pl.formula: 40% × unearned income (RC-and-sale based) + 100% × ASR land difference for base FSI shift
premium_case_B_base_fsi_shift_between_pl.unearned_income_calc: Sale valuation of transferred component minus cost of construction of sale and Planning Authority component minus statutory payments to authorities
premium_case_B_base_fsi_shift_between_pl.payment_stages: 50% at IOA, 50% at CC; alternatively developer surrenders equivalent BUA valued at ASR sale rate

clubbing_provisions.not_permitted_for: SRA schemes under clause 3.11 of Reg 33(10)

premium_utilization.note: Original DCPR text: 2/3 shelter fund, 1/3 Dept of Town Planning

cross_references.reg_33_10: Uses Reg 33(10)(8) for amenity list; not combinable with 33(10) clause 3.11 SRS scheme via clubbing
cross_references.sra_planning_authority: SRA is Planning Authority for PTC + Rental Housing

operational_fsi_split_verified.description: Verified against Bhagwan Apartment (Worli Hill, 1575 sqm, 24m road), Abdul Court + Kachwalla (Mahim, 1578 sqm, 18.4m road), JAI GIRNAR (Tardeo, 3346 sqm, 36.6m road). All three use the industry 63/37 split of Additional FSI between SRA-PTC and Sale+Society.

formula.additional_bua_sqm: plot_area_sqm × additional_fsi (max 2.67 Island / 3.00 Suburbs; road-width-dependent per Table A above)
formula.sra_ptc_share_bua_sqm: additional_bua_sqm × 0.63 (SRA gets 63% of Additional FSI — handed over as PTC/Rental)
formula.fungible_35pct_on_each: Both SRA-PTC and Sale+Society components add 35% fungible (residential)

convention_note.63_pct_of_additional: The SRA share is 63% of the ADDITIONAL FSI (not of total). Industry practice from NKPC feasibilities.
convention_note.existing_carpet_additional_pct: 50% on MOFA / 55% on RERA carpet (Bhagwan) or 50%/55% (Abdul) or 30%/35% (JAI GIRNAR — depends on scheme age/tier). User-configurable input.
convention_note.additional_fsi_override: NKPC feasibilities routinely use max 2.67 (Island) even for plots <2000 sqm if road ≥ 18m. Calculator accepts user override; default is the strict DCPR table value.
